used_lines: sab kehte hain waqt sab theek kar deta hai, / mera waqt to bas yaadein de gaya.
sab kehte hain akela rehna buri baat hai, / par bheed mein bhi to main akela hi tha.
kuch baatein dil mein hi achi lagti hain, / zuban par aate hi rishtey tod deti hain.
woh jo kabhi jaan hua karte the, / aaj unka naam lene par bhi khamoshi cha jati hai.
raat gehri ho to yaadein cheekhti hain, / din ke ujalon mein hum muskura kar thak jaate hain.
